FIELDS.NAME: ColorSplash Paint & Wallpaper Store
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At ColorSplash Paint & Wallpaper Store, we specialize in retail sales of high-quality paints, wallpapers, and related home improvement supplies. Our operations focus on providing exceptional customer service, including expert color matching and consultation services within our store. We maintain a diverse selection of products, including eco-friendly and low-VOC options, catering to both residential and commercial customers. Our store features an organized showroom with clear emergency exits and accessible aisles, ensuring a safe shopping environment. We prioritize compliance with all environmental and safety regulations while providing training to our staff on the safe handling and disposal of hazardous materials. Although we occasionally offer limited local delivery services, we do not engage in any on-site painting or installation work, allowing us to maintain a focused retail environment that minimizes liability and risk.

Our store specializes in selling high-quality paints and wallpaper, and we also provide on-site painting and wallpaper installation services to help our customers achieve their desired look for their homes and businesses.
